Optimization & Learning

Supporting study

Fuzzy resource allocation

Evaluated robust production decisions under triangular profit and resource uncertainty.

  • Alpha cuts
  • Linear programming
Main outcome

An uncertainty-aware allocation model with an independent LP reference.

Motivation

The study examined resource allocation when factory profits and available quantities were uncertain.

Implementation

Alpha-cut linear programs compare robust, nominal, optimistic and original policies. Independent feasible-vertex enumeration checks the HiGHS solutions.

Results

Robust objective profit increases from 90.45 to 105.0 as alpha goes from zero to one; all thirty-six cases match the independent objective reference.

Limitations

Synthetic two-product model. Alpha denotes fuzzy membership, not probability; policy objectives use different coefficients.

Evidence boundary

A small supporting uncertainty study; no carbon-storage or probabilistic-confidence claim.
